queries.q-worry: I keep worrying about money and what will happen tomorrow. What did Wesley say about anxiety and taking thought for the future?
queries.q-worry-plain: Bills keep piling up and I lie awake fretting about how we'll get by next month. How do I stop being so anxious about what's coming?

queries.q-assurance: How can I know that I am really a child of God? What did Wesley teach about the assurance of salvation?
queries.q-assurance-plain: Some days I feel sure God has forgiven me and other days I'm not sure at all. Is there any way to actually be certain I belong to him?

queries.q-money: Is it wrong for a Christian to try to earn more money? What did Wesley say about making a living?
queries.q-money-plain: Is it okay to work hard for a bigger paycheck, or should a follower of Jesus not care about getting ahead?

queries.q-riches: Can a Christian be wealthy without it hurting their soul? What did Wesley say about the danger of riches?
queries.q-riches-plain: I've done well in business and now have a lot more than I need. Could having all this be bad for me spiritually?

queries.q-prayer: How should I pray when I am alone? What did Wesley say about private prayer?

queries.q-forgiveness: Someone hurt me and I cannot let it go. What did Wesley say about forgiving people who wrong us?

queries.q-perfection: What does Wesley mean by Christian perfection? Can a believer be made perfect in this life?
queries.q-perfection-plain: Is it possible to stop sinning altogether and love God with my whole heart before I die, or will I always fall short?

queries.q-heaviness: I have been sad for a long time and my faith feels heavy. What did Wesley say about heaviness and sorrow in a believer?
queries.q-heaviness-plain: I've felt low and weighed down for months, even though I still trust God. Is something wrong with me spiritually?

queries.q-mourning: My child died and I do not know how to grieve. What did Wesley say about mourning the dead?
queries.q-mourning-plain: My little boy passed away last month and I can't stop crying. How do I go on after losing a child?

queries.q-satan: I feel like the devil is attacking my faith. What did Wesley say about Satan's devices?
queries.q-satan-plain: Something keeps pulling me away from God and wearing me down until I want to give up. How do I stand firm?

queries.q-temptation: The temptation I am facing feels too strong to bear. What did Wesley say about God making a way to escape?
queries.q-temptation-plain: I keep getting pulled toward something I know is wrong and I feel too weak to say no. Will God help me get through it?

queries.q-communion: How often should a Christian receive the Lord's Supper? What did Wesley teach about communion?
queries.q-communion-plain: How often should I take the bread and the cup at church? Is a few times a year enough?

queries.q-means: What are the means of grace, and do they actually help a person grow?
queries.q-means-plain: Do things like praying, reading the Bible and going to church actually help me get closer to God, or are they just habits?

queries.q-salvation: If I cannot earn heaven, how is a person saved? What did Wesley say about salvation by faith?
queries.q-salvation-plain: I'll never be good enough for heaven no matter how hard I try. So how does anybody get right with God?

queries.q-justification: What does it mean to be justified? Does Wesley say God justifies good people or ungodly people?
queries.q-justification-plain: Does God only accept good people, or will he forgive someone who has done terrible things?

queries.q-faith-works: If we are saved by faith alone, do good works still matter? What did Wesley say about faith and works together?
queries.q-faith-works-plain: If trusting Jesus is what puts me right with God, does it matter how I live or whether I help people? Do the things I do count for anything?

queries.q-new-birth: What does it mean to be born again? What did Wesley preach about the new birth?
queries.q-new-birth-plain: People at church say I need God to give me a whole fresh start on the inside. What actually changes in a person when that happens?

queries.q-sin-believers: I am a Christian and I still struggle with pride and unbelief. Did Wesley say that sin remains in believers?
queries.q-sin-believers-plain: I gave my life to Jesus years ago but I still catch myself being proud and doubting. Does that mean I was never really saved?

queries.q-original-sin: Are people basically good? What did Wesley teach about original sin and the human heart?
queries.q-original-sin-plain: Are people good deep down and just pick up bad habits, or is something wrong with us from the very start?

queries.q-catholic-spirit: How should I treat Christians who disagree with me on doctrine? What did Wesley mean by a catholic spirit?
queries.q-catholic-spirit-plain: My friend goes to a church that teaches very differently from mine. Can we still be close and work together without pretending our differences don't matter?

queries.q-backsliders: I used to believe and then I fell away. What did Wesley say to backsliders who think God will not take them back?
queries.q-backsliders-plain: I walked away from God years ago. I want to come back, but I'm scared he won't have me. Is it too late?

queries.q-self-denial: What does it mean to deny yourself and take up your cross? What did Wesley say about self-denial?
queries.q-self-denial-plain: Do I really have to give up things I want in order to follow Jesus? How much is God asking me to let go of?

queries.q-wandering-thoughts: My mind wanders when I try to pray. Are wandering thoughts a sin? What did Wesley say?
queries.q-wandering-thoughts-plain: When I pray, my mind keeps drifting off to my shopping list and my job. Is God upset with me for that?

queries.q-wilderness: I used to feel close to God, and now everything feels dark. What did Wesley say about the wilderness state?
queries.q-wilderness-plain: A few years ago I felt so close to God and full of joy. Now I feel empty and far away from him. What happened, and can I get that back?

queries.q-evil-speaking: Is it gossip if what I say about someone is true? What did Wesley teach about evil-speaking?
queries.q-evil-speaking-plain: Is it wrong to talk about a coworker behind their back if everything I say is true?
